methods.label: Add the class totals
methods.explanation:
Add the contestants from the three mathematics classes to find the school total:
\[
11+8+9=19+9=28.
\]
Thus \(\boxed{28}\) students are taking the contest, choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
methods.levelReason: Requires only adding small whole-number counts.

candidate.annotationRationale: The calculation is mental addition within 100. The part-total relationship supports combining the three class counts into one school total.
